title: List of Bishoprics by Province
english: Pitane, Myrina, Phocaea, Aureliopolis, Nymphaion, Maschakom, the Metropolitans, Vareto, Magnesia and Anelia, Anina, Pergamon, Priela, Arcadiopolis, Andreas, the Temple of Zeus, Augaza, Sion, Colophon, Lebedus, Teos, Erythrae, Eklyzomenoi, Antandros, Theodosiopolis, Perperis, Cyme, and Palaeopolis. Province of Europe in Thrace: The Metropolis of Heracleia has five cities, namely the bishoprics of Panium, Callipolis, Chersonesus, Kula, and Rhaidesto.

Province of Galatia [Thrace]: The Metropolis of Ancyra has six cities, namely the bishoprics of Tabia, Heliopolis, Asponis, Berinopolis, Mnēzus, and Kinē, and Anastasiopolis. Province of Hellespont: The Metropolis of Cyzicus has twelve cities, namely the bishoprics of Germē, Pemanos, Okes, Sasabares, Adrian of the Beasts, Lampsacus, Abydos, Dardanos, Ilios, Troy, Pionia, and Melitupolis.

Province of Lydia: The Metropolis of Sardis has ten cities, namely the bishoprics of Philadelphia, Tripolis, Thyatira, Settos, Aureliopolis, Tripolis, Gordos, Tralles, Salos, Silandus, Maionia, the Temple of Apollo, Hyrcanides, Mustines, Akrasa, Apolloniades, Attaleia, Bagē, Blandus, Mesotymolos, Hierocaesarea, Dalda, Kerasē, Stratonikeia, Gabala, Sattalos, and Hermoupolis. Province of Bithynia: The Metropolis of Nicomedia has seven cities, namely the bishoprics of Prousia or Theopolis, Basilopolis, Praeneta, Apolloniades, Dasculium, Gallos, Neocaesarea, and Kolasia or Lophos.

Province of the same [Bithynia]: The Metropolis of Nicaea has three cities, namely the bishoprics of Modrin or Melitus, Linōē, and Gordoserbon. Province of the same [Bithynia]: The Metropolis of Chalcedon. Province of Pamphylia: The Metropolis of Side has ten cities, namely the bishoprics of Selge, Aspendus, Ettene, Orymnus, Kasōn, Semneōn, Karalia, Karakisia, Syedron, Miloma or Justinianopolis, Ouamandron, Dalisan, Isbos, Lyrbe, Kolibrassos, and Manaygon.

Province of Armenia II: The Metropolis of Sebaste has five cities, namely the bishoprics of Sebaste, Nicopolis, Sattalos, Coloniae, and Berissa. Province of Helenopontus: The Metropolis of Amasia has [number missing] cities, namely the bishoprics of Aminso, Sinope, Iboron, Andrapōn, Zalichon or Leontopolis, and Zelon. title: List of Bishoprics and Provinces
english: five bishops, namely Arkes, Koukos, Arabissos, Ariarathēs, and Komanoi. Province of Cappadocia: 2. The Metropolis of Tyana has under it 3 cities, namely Kybistron, Faustinopolis, and Sasimon. Province of Paphlagonia: The Metropolis of Gangra has under it 4 cities, namely Amastris, Iounopolis, Dadubron, and Soron. Province of Ononorias: The Metropolis of Claudiopolis has under it 5 cities, namely Heracleia Pontica, Prousiad, Tyos, Krateia, and Adrianopolis. Province of Polemoniacus Pontus: The Metropolis of Neocaesarea has under it 4 cities, namely Trapezus, Kerasus, Polemonion, and Komanoi. Province of Galatia: 2. The Metropolis of Pisinuntus has under it 7 cities, namely Amorium, Klana, Eudoxiad, Pitanisus, Troknad, Germokolonia, and Palia. Province of Lycia: The Metropolis of Myra has under it 12 cities, namely Mastaur, Telmessos, Elimyr, Araxes, Aprilon, Apodalia, Orykandos, Tatlon, Arneon, Sydymon, Zenonopolis, and Olympos. Also Tlon, Korydallos, Kano, Akrassos, Xanthos, Bobos or Sophianopolis, Markianē, Oinundon, Choma, Fellon, Antiphellon, Phaselias, Rhodias, Akalissos, Lebesos, Akandros, Palaio, Eudokia or Justinopolis, Komnon, Patar, Balburon, Neson, Kyanon, and Melonion. Province of Caria: The Metropolis of Stavroupolis has under it 27 cities, namely Kybira, Sizon, Heracleia Salvakon, Apolloniad, Heracleia Lakymon, Tabon, Larbon, Antioch of Maiandros, Tapassos, Harpasos, Neapolis, Orthosias, Anotetartēs, Lavandon, Stratonikeia, Alkandon, Mylasa, Meizon, Iassos, Barbylion, Halicarnassus, Hilarimon, Cnidus, Metabon, Myndos, Hieros, Kindramos, and Keramon. Province of Phrygia Cappadociana: The Metropolis of Laodicea has under it 26 cities, namely Tiberiopolis, Azanos, Ancyra Synao, Pelton, Appia, Kadon, Ikrion, Helozon, Tranopolis, Sebasteia, Eumenes, Timenon of the beasts, Agathokomeia, Alion, Tripolis, Attanasos, Siblion. Province of Phrygia Salutaris: The Metropolis of Synada has under it 14 cities, namely Kotyaion, Dorulaion, Nakoleia, Dokimion, Medaia, Ipsos, Promnesos, Meron, Sibindos, and [...]

title: List of Provinces and Bishoprics
english: Polyvotos of Phuteia, Hierapolis, Eukarpia, Lyssiades, Augustopolis, Brozos, Otros, Lykaon, Stektor, Kinnabor, Konis Demetropolis, Scordaspis, Nicopolis, and Auroklon.

Province of Lycaonia: The Metropolis of Iconium has under it 14 cities, namely, bishoprics: Lystra, the Vasades, the Amblades, the Umanades, the Misthians, the Larandes, the Baretas, Derbe, the Sanatras, Kanou, the Berinupolians, the Galvans, Lystra, and the Pertas.

Province of Pisidia: The Metropolis of Antioch has under it 17 cities, namely, bishoprics: Philomelium, Sagalas, Sozupolis, Apamea of Kinos, Raia, Bare, Adrianopolis, Limenon, Neapolis, Laodicea of Chonae, Seleucia, Sidara, Adadon, the Zozeloi, Timbriada, Justinianopolis, the Metropolis, and Papos.

Province of Pamphylia: The Metropolis of Perga has under it 18 cities, namely, bishoprics: Attalia, the Eudoxiad, Telmissos, Sindos, Maximianopolis, the Lagina, the Palaeopolis, Cremna, the Kudroulons, Peltinussa, Aresassos, the Puglons, Adrian, the Dikitanauros, the Sandidons, the Varai, the Sylai, and the Pervain.
Province of Cappadocia: The Metropolis of Mazaca has under it 4 cities, namely, bishoprics: Nazianzus, Coloneia, Parnassus, and the Dowars.
Province of Lazica: The Metropolis of Phasis has under it 4 cities, namely, bishoprics: Rhodopolis, the Sahesines, Peter, and the Ziganes.
Province of Thrace: The Metropolis of Philippopolis has under it 3 cities, namely, bishoprics: Diocletianopolis, Sebastopolis, and Diospolis.
Province of Europe: The Metropolis of Trajan has under it 2 cities, namely, bishoprics: Pieros and Anastasiopolis.
Province of the Cyclades Islands: The Metropolis of Rhodes has under it 12 cities, namely, bishoprics: Samos, Chios, Kos, Naxos, Thera, Paros, Leros, Andros, Tinos, Melos, and Pitynous.
Province of Aemimontus: The Metropolis of Adrian has under it 5 cities, namely, bishoprics: Mesembria, Sozupolis, Plutinoupolis, Anastasiopolis, and the Zoidoi.
Province of the same [Aemimontus]: The Metropolis of Marcian has under it 5 cities, namely, bishoprics: Rhodostolos, the Tramariskons, the Novon, the Zekedespon, and Skaria.
Province of Cappadocian Phrygia: The Metropolis of Hierapolis has under it 5 cities, namely, bishoprics: Melupolis, Dionysiopolis, Anastasiopolis, the Attudoi, and Mosynon.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
